title: ACS Newsletter, volume III, number 10
version: November 1974 issue, in Computer History Museum composite archive
lineage: Contemporary newsletter. Inspected issue heading and Altair notice in archive OCR; retained file is a paraphrased note.

passages.locator: November 1974 issue, COMPUTER KITS, Altair 8800 Computer Kit
passages.note: The November 1974 ACS Newsletter volume III number 10 describes a forthcoming Popular Electronics article on the MITS Altair 8800 kit, 8080 processor and anticipated kit pricing. This notice does not itself establish completed shipment or sale.
